<p class="wtl-note">All materials link to their original publishers; a free PDF chapter is not the same as a freely available full book. Last link review: October 22, 2026. External websites may change accessibility without notice.</p>

<script>
(function () {
  function initializeLibrary() {
    const input=document.getElementById('wtl-search');
    const count=document.getElementById('wtl-result-count');
    if(!input || !count) return;
    let level='All';
    const buttons=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-wtl-filter]')];
    function activePane(){
      return document.querySelector('.panel-tabset .tab-content .tab-pane.active') ||
             document.querySelector('.panel-tabset .tab-content .tab-pane') ||
             document.querySelector('.panel-tabset');
    }
    function update(){
      const term=input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      const pane=activePane();
      if(!pane) return;
      let total=0,shown=0;
      for(const card of document.querySelectorAll('.wtl-card')){
        const text=card.textContent.toLowerCase();
        const visible=(level==='All'||card.dataset.level===level)&&(!term||text.includes(term));
        card.hidden=!visible;
      }
      for(const card of pane.querySelectorAll('.wtl-card')){
        total++;if(!card.hidden)shown++;
      }
      count.textContent=shown+' articles shown in this topic';
      const noResults=pane.querySelector('.wtl-no-results');
      if(noResults)noResults.hidden=shown!==0;
      buttons.forEach(b=>{const current=b.dataset.wtlFilter===level;b.classList.toggle('active',current);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(current));});
    }
    input.addEventListener('input',update);
    buttons.forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{level=b.dataset.wtlFilter;update();}));
    document.addEventListener('shown.bs.tab',update);
    document.querySelectorAll('.panel-tabset button, .panel-tabset a[role="tab"]').forEach(t=>t.addEventListener('click',()=>requestAnimationFrame(update)));
    update();
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',initializeLibrary);
  else initializeLibrary();
})();
</script>
